classes.name: affiliate
classes.label: affiliate
classes.definition: party that is related to a legal entity, directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, and controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with that entity, typically determined by the degree of ownership

classes.name: affiliation
classes.label: affiliation
classes.definition: situation in which a controlled party is affiliated with a controlling party for some period of time

classes.name: controlled affiliate
classes.label: controlled affiliate
classes.definition: controlled party in an affiliation situation

classes.name: controlling affiliate
classes.label: controlling affiliate
classes.definition: controlling party in an affiliation situation

classes.name: domestic ultimate parent
classes.label: domestic ultimate parent
classes.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization within the country or jurisdiction of incorporation or organization

classes.name: global ultimate parent
classes.label: global ultimate parent
classes.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization world-wide

classes.name: joint venture partner
classes.label: joint venture partner
classes.definition: party that shares capital, technology, human resources, risks, and benefits of an entity under shared control

classes.name: significant shareholder
classes.label: significant shareholder
classes.definition: party that owns a significant voting stake in an organization that is less than 50 percent but greater than some threshold

classes.name: subsidiary
classes.label: subsidiary
classes.definition: legal entity that is entirely or majority owned and controlled by another legal entity

classes.name: total controlling interest party
classes.label: total controlling interest party
classes.definition: voting shareholder that owns 100 percent of the voting shares in some legal entity

classes.name: voting shareholder
classes.label: voting shareholder
classes.definition: shareholder whose shares confer the right to vote in corporate elections, including the right to elect directors at annual or special meetings, and to express their views to corporate management and directors on significant issues that may affect the value of those shares

edges.name: has affiliate
edges.label: has affiliate
edges.definition: has a party which directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with the company

edges.name: has controlling affiliate
edges.label: has controlling affiliate
edges.definition: is directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controlled by

edges.name: has domestic ultimate parent
edges.label: has domestic ultimate parent
edges.definition: relates an organization to another recognized as its ultimate parent, within its country or jurisdiction of incorporation, if it has one

edges.name: has global ultimate parent
edges.label: has global ultimate parent
edges.definition: relates an organization to another recognized as its ultimate parent, if it has one

edges.name: has subsidiary
edges.label: has subsidiary
edges.definition: relates a legal entity to another organization that it owns at least 50 percent of

edges.name: is affiliate of
edges.label: is affiliate of
edges.definition: relates a party which directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control by another party to that party

edges.name: is controlling affiliate of
edges.label: is controlling affiliate of
edges.definition: controls directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries

edges.name: is parent company of
edges.label: is parent company of
edges.definition: indicates a controlled affiliate that it owns at least 50 percent of

edges.name: is subsidiary of
edges.label: is subsidiary of
edges.definition: is controlled directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries and owned at least 50 percent by

edges.name: is wholly owned by
edges.label: is wholly owned by
edges.definition: relates a legal entity to a party that has 100 percent ownership and control over it
